subject: mathematics_1b
question_text: The total revenue in rupees from the sale of x units of a product is R(x) = 3x² + 36x + 5. Find the marginal revenue at x = 5. (Marginal revenue is the rate of change of total revenue.)

recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — say what marginal revenue means and what you do with x = 5.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Differentiate the revenue function
steps.margin_note: First mark. This is a rate measure question, the twin of the marginal cost one. Differentiate term by term: 3x² gives 6x, 36x gives 36, and the constant 5 gives 0.
steps.memory_tip: Marginal means derivative. Marginal revenue is dR/dx, exactly as marginal cost is dC/dx.
lines: This is a rate measure question. Marginal revenue is the rate of change of total revenue,

recall.must_convey: That marginal revenue is dR/dx, and that differentiating R(x) gives 6x + 36.
accept: marginal revenue is the derivative of the revenue function
differentiate R of x and get six x plus thirty six
marginal revenue means d R by d x
marginal revenue ante derivative, differentiate cheyyali
the constant five differentiates to zero

steps.why: The question defines marginal revenue for you as a rate of change, so the method is one differentiation. Writing dR/dx before substituting earns the method mark on its own.
common_mistakes: Substituting x = 5 into R(x), which gives the total revenue 260 and not the rate.
Carrying the constant 5 into the derivative.

steps.label: Substitute x = 5
steps.margin_note: Second mark. 6 × 5 = 30 and 30 + 36 = 66. The unit is rupees per unit, because revenue in rupees is differentiated with respect to the number of units.
steps.memory_tip: Substitute only after the derivative is written down — the number goes into dR/dx, never into R(x).

lines.text: ∴ marginal revenue at x = 5 is 66 rupees per unit

recall.must_convey: That substituting x = 5 into 6x + 36 gives 66 rupees per unit.
accept: put x equals five to get sixty six rupees per unit
six into five is thirty, plus thirty six is sixty six
the marginal revenue is sixty six rupees
five substitute cheste sixty six vasthundi
the answer is sixty six rupees per unit

steps.why: The answer is a rate of rupees against units, so the unit is rupees per unit of product. It is the extra revenue from selling one more unit around x = 5.
common_mistakes: Giving 260, which is R(5) and not the rate.
Leaving the answer with no unit.

insider_note: Marginal revenue is dR/dx, so differentiate before substituting. The constant 5 disappears entirely, which is a useful check.
